start.text: (sitting on a cement bag. eating rice from a metal box. doesn't look up.) ...
(sitting on a cement bag. eating rice from a metal box. doesn't look up.) ...

hello_resp.text: (chews. swallows. takes a sip from a thermos that's older than you.) ...you're standing in the way of the truck. ...truck comes at noon. ...it's not noon yet. but it will be.

waiting.text: (five minutes pass. he finishes eating. puts the metal box down. finally looks at you.) ...you waited. ...most people don't wait. ...you need something. or you're lost. ...either way, sit down. the cement's dry.

moved.text: (nods.) ...good. ...the site closes at six. don't be here after six. ...things are different after six. ...the workers go home. something else comes to work.

work_here.text: work. (looks at his hands. looks at the building going up. looks back at his hands.) ...twenty years. ...the building goes up. another one comes down. ...the city breathes. ...you just have to be careful where you stand when it exhales.

sit_down.text: (silence. a truck passes. dust settles.) ...you remind me of someone. ...can't remember who. ...doesn't matter. they didn't stay either. ...if you're looking for work, the foreman's office is behind the blue fence. if you're looking for something else... ...the old market. the one with the loud woman. she knows things. ...just buy something first. she doesn't talk to freeloaders.
